Saisie pas à pas : maintenir les touches: Step input: hold the desired keys, then → to insert and advance. Settings in this panel.
Maintenir une ou plusieurs touches, puis: Hold one or more keys, then press → in the piano roll to insert these notes and advance by the chosen duration. Releasing without advancing creates no notes. The visual grid stays independent.
Pour capturer les attaques et les durées: To capture played attacks and durations, close this panel, then press R or the ● button. Space finishes the take, without quantization.
Jouer pour préécouter. R ou ● pour enreg: Play to audition. R or ● records in real time; Space finishes. The Step input panel offers entry with a chosen duration.
Dernière prise : environ {0} BPM · À con: Last take: approximately {0} BPM · Confirm to apply
Dernière prise : estimation insuffisante: Last take: too little data or rhythm too irregular to estimate.
BPM estimé de la dernière prise : ≈ {0}: Estimated BPM of the last take: ≈ {0}
Proposition indicative, ambiguë à la moi: Indicative proposal, ambiguous at half or double tempo. Notes are never moved or quantized. BPM changes only after confirmation.
Le précompte reste audible même si le cl: The count-in remains audible even when the click is disabled.
Activer puis glisser une note vers une a: Enable, then drag a note to another voice. Pitch and timing are preserved. Escape cancels.
Ce nom sert aux exports MIDI. Les fichie: This name is used for MIDI exports. Existing files are not renamed.
Enregistrer ces réglages ne modifie pas: Saving these settings does not change notes. Then click Analyse; available neural outputs are reused.
Basic Pitch est inclus et fonctionne sur: Basic Pitch is included and runs on CPU. To add MuScriptor, choose its GGUF folder.
Les variantes MuScriptor présentes appar: Available MuScriptor variants appear in the engine list. Weights are checked by SHA-256; no automatic download.
Trop de notes Basic Pitch : réduisez la: Too many Basic Pitch notes: reduce note sensitivity.
Empreinte du modèle ou du moteur Basic P: Basic Pitch model or runtime checksum mismatch.
Chargement d’ONNX Runtime CPU impossible: Unable to load ONNX Runtime CPU.
Dimensions de sortie ONNX Basic Pitch in: Unexpected Basic Pitch ONNX output shape.
Cache Basic Pitch indisponible : lancez: Basic Pitch cache unavailable: click Analyse.
Transcription ajoutée dans une nouvelle: Transcription added as a new voice · Ctrl+Z to undo.
Aucune note détectée : aucune voix ajout: No notes detected: no voice added.
Les réglages remplaceront les correction: These settings will replace corrections in this voice. Other voices are preserved.
MuScriptor · traitement commun aux trois: MuScriptor · shared processing for all three models

Consultez les textes de licence dans le: Read the licence texts in the third-party folder supplied with Phthongos.
Impossible d’ouvrir le manuel PDF livré: Unable to open the PDF manual supplied with Phthongos.
Poids MuScriptor · Kyutai et Mirelo · CC: MuScriptor weights · Kyutai and Mirelo · CC BY-NC 4.0 · non-commercial use. Downloaded separately from Hugging Face.
Estimation sur la voix active, ou toutes: Estimate from the active voice, or all voices when All parts is selected. Individually muted notes are ignored.
Notes analysées : {0} attaques distincte: Analysed notes: {0} distinct onsets. At least 2 are needed to estimate BPM.
Notes analysées : les attaques sont trop: Analysed notes: onsets are too close together to estimate BPM.
Notes analysées : trop peu d’intervalles: Analysed notes: too few usable intervals to estimate BPM.
Notes analysées : plusieurs pulsations r: Analysed notes: several pulses remain possible. No sufficiently reliable BPM to suggest.
Estimation relative · V1 piano. Voix ver: Relative estimate · V1 piano. Locked voices and percussion are excluded.
Les réglages réutilisent les mesures. Re: Settings reuse the measurements. Recalculate renews measurements without changing notes. Apply replaces velocities in the chosen scope.
